description:
Donald Keene didn't realize he was drafting humanity's mass grave until Senator Thurman handed him a pencil and called it emergency fallout storage.

In this comprehensive breakdown of "Shift" by Hugh Howey (the prequel to Wool and Book 2 of the Silo Series), we uncover how an architecture of fifty subterranean silos was designed by men who drugged themselves into forgetting the very world they burned. From the 2049 CAD drafting rooms in Washington D.C. to the cryo shifts of Silo 1, the 144-level rebellion of Silo 18, and Jimmy Parker's 34-year survival as Solo in Silo 17, explore the terrifying 500-year Seed protocol and the devastating price of engineered survival.
